title: ‘Too many lawyers’: the problem with Europe’s human rights NGOs
lede: Traditionally, human rights NGOs have been staffed mainly by lawyers. This is understandable. But advocacy is becoming less effective because decision makers increasingly see supporting human rights as politically risky.
